_comment: Copy this file to contextforge.config.json and fill in your values. Never commit your real config — it's gitignored.

llm._comment: Supported backends: openai, anthropic, grok, ollama, custom
llm._ollama_example: If using ollama, set backend to 'ollama' and set ollama_url below
llm._custom_example: If using a custom endpoint, set backend to 'custom' and set custom_endpoint below

voice._comment: Set tts_enabled/stt_enabled to false to disable either independently
voice._tts_comment: Supported TTS backends: elevenlabs, openai, pyttsx3, custom
voice._stt_comment: Supported STT backends: whisper_api, whisper_local, custom

tts._elevenlabs: ElevenLabs — best quality. Get your voice_id from elevenlabs.io/voice-library
tts._openai: OpenAI TTS — swap tts_backend to 'openai' and set these
tts._pyttsx3: pyttsx3 — local/offline, no API key. Swap tts_backend to 'pyttsx3'
tts._custom: Custom TTS endpoint — swap tts_backend to 'custom'

stt._whisper_api: Whisper via OpenAI API — accurate, costs a tiny amount per minute
stt._whisper_local: Local Whisper — free, runs on your machine. Swap stt_backend to 'whisper_local'
stt._silence: Stop recording after this much quiet
stt._custom: Custom STT endpoint — swap stt_backend to 'custom'

dm._comment: Filled in automatically during first-launch onboarding. You can set these manually to skip it.

memory._comment_player_id: Change this if you want multiple player profiles on the same machine.
